gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent Glioblastoma (WHO-Grade IV Glioma); Recurrent Glioblastoma; Glioblastoma (GBM); Recurrent Glioblastoma IDH Wildtype

Histologically confirmed glioblastoma (based on the 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System, 5th edition), and confirmed CA IX/CA XII positive by histology or \[68Ga\]Ga-XT771 PET/CT.

candidate_evidence.quote: Investigational Drug: \[177Lu\]Lu-XT771 is an investigational, first-in-human (FIH) targeted radiopharmaceutical. It is designed to specifically bind to CA IX and CA XII receptors on the tumor cell surface.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed recurrence of glioblastoma following prior treatments.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: It will be quantified using serial whole-body planar scintigraphy and SPECT/CT imaging to measure drug distribution and calculate the cumulative radiation absorbed dose in the tumor cavity and critical normal organs (e.g., kidneys).
These scans will quantify the drug's distribution and the radiation dose absorbed by both the tumor lesions and normal organs (such as the kidneys).

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive a single-dose locoregional injection of 3-5 mCi of the investigational radiopharmaceutical, \[177Lu\]Lu-XT771. The drug will be administered directly into the tumor resection cavity via a surgically implanted Ommaya reservoir.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational lutetium-177-labelled CA IX/CA XII-targeted radioligand ([177Lu]Lu-XT771)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Binds CA IX and CA XII on tumour cells; Lutetium-177 delivers localized beta radiation to tumour cells

role_evidence.quote: Prior to the therapeutic injection, a leakage test using a \[68Ga\]Ga-XT771 tracer will be performed to ensure there is no leakage into the subcutaneous or subarachnoid spaces.

agents.drug_class_hint: gallium-68-labelled CA IX/CA XII PET tracer used for leakage test and target screening

role_evidence.quote: Furthermore, to mitigate radiation-induced cerebral edema, the intervention is paired with a prophylactic regimen of oral dexamethasone (4 mg, three times daily) for 4 days.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: Carbonic anhydrase IX / XII (CA IX/CA XII) positivity by histology or [68Ga]Ga-XT771 PET/CT

source_quote.quote: Histologically confirmed glioblastoma (based on the 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System, 5th edition), and confirmed CA IX/CA XII positive by histology or \[68Ga\]Ga-XT771 PET/CT.

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 (translational subset). Single-arm locoregional radioligand therapy via Ommaya reservoir into the resection cavity. [68Ga]Ga-XT771 (leakage test/screening PET) and oral dexamethasone (oedema prophylaxis) are not registered interventions but are given to every patient per the arm description, so listed as diagnostic_agent and supportive. formulation_flag new_route for intracavitary (Ommaya) administration of a first-in-human agent; device_dependent coded false because the Ommaya reservoir is an access catheter, not a device that activates the drug or opens the BBB - adjudicator may consider R4. tumour_pk_planned coded yes because SPECT/CT quantifies drug distribution in the tumour cavity (imaging biodistribution/dosimetry, not tissue concentration). CA IX/XII positivity is an entry requirement directly matched to the CA IX/XII-targeting candidate. IDH-wildtype appears only in conditions, not recorded as a biomarker row.
